desc: The Match 3.0 may be the prefect rifle for the shooter who is torn between the Watchman and the RECON. The 22" steel barrel starts as a Bartlein blank and splits the difference between the velocity of the 24" and 18" barrels. No quality is lost with the Match 3.0 as it possesses the same essential, class defining features as the Watchman and Recon. The Match 3.0 has a Magpul PRS rifle stock that will allow the shooter enough comfort to stay on the gun for extended periods of time.
